description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyabalagoda, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520022
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically correcting parcel numbers, land extents, owner names, and identity card numbers for various land parcels. It involves detailed land administration matters including cadastral mapping, land parcel identification, and title corrections - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
